feature_definitions.return_1: Close-to-close return versus the previous bar.
feature_definitions.log_return: Natural log of close / previous close.
feature_definitions.volatility_20: Standard deviation of log returns over the last 20 bars (including the current bar).
feature_definitions.volume_ratio: Volume divided by the mean volume of the previous 20 bars.
feature_definitions.volume_zscore: (Volume - mean of previous 20 bars) / std of previous 20 bars.
feature_definitions.ma20_distance: Close versus the mean close of the previous 20 bars.
feature_definitions.rsi_14: Wilder RSI over 14 bars (causal exponential smoothing).
feature_definitions.relative_return: Return minus the NIFTY 50 return for the same trading date (NaN when the benchmark is unavailable).
